hero.title: Your money, organised - without handing it over.
hero.subtitle: Ledgerly tracks accounts, categorises your spending automatically and keeps your budgets honest, with sensitive details encrypted before they're ever stored.
hero.noCard: No card required. Starter categories and rules are set up for you.

features.title: Built for people who actually reconcile their statements

accounts.title: All your accounts, one place
accounts.description: Current, savings, credit, cash and investments; each with a live balance calculated from opening balance plus transactions.

import.title: CSV import that just works
import.description: Drop a bank export and columns are auto-mapped. Duplicates are flagged, both number formats and delimiters are handled, before you commit.

rules.title: Rules that categorise for you
rules.description: Match on description, merchant, amount ranges or regex. Rules run automatically on import, or re-run on everything you already have.

dashboard.title: A dashboard you actually control
dashboard.description: Drag widgets anywhere on a live grid and resize them freely, then pick how each one visualises your data - bar, line, donut or list - down to drilling into a category's own subcategories.

budgets.title: Budgets, goals and transfers
budgets.description: Monthly per-category limits, savings goals linked to an account, two-legged transfers kept out of your spending totals.

categories.title: Categories that fit your life
categories.description: Colour-coded, split into spending and income, with optional sub-categories (plus automatic recurring-payment detection).

privacy.title: A budgeting app that isn't built on reading your budget
privacy.intro: Most budgeting tools store your transaction details in plain text. Ledgerly encrypts the sensitive fields before they're stored, so a raw copy of the database alone doesn't expose them.

encryptedAtRest.title: Encrypted at rest
encryptedAtRest.description: Transaction descriptions, merchants and notes are encrypted before they're ever written to the database.

defenceInDepth.title: Defence in depth
defenceInDepth.description: The encryption key is held separately from the database itself, so a database leak alone doesn't expose your transaction details.

noDataResale.title: No data reselling
noDataResale.description: Your data lives in a single database operated directly by whoever runs this instance - not resold to data brokers or analytics platforms, and never shared with advertisers.

cta.title: Set up your ledger in a couple of minutes
cta.subtitle: Create an account, import a statement, and watch your budgets and net worth update themselves.
